phases.name: Choose an opening your attacker can control
phases.text: List the debuffs your rotation applies, including Parry Stun. If an opening would apply one, check Ultron's dormant icon first: it determines the buff that application activates.

phases.name: Decide whether the resulting buff is manageable
phases.text: Power Gain can accelerate his specials; Regeneration can undo your damage. Delay the debuff unless you can handle that result. Armor Up and Fury present different tradeoffs, so keep reading the changing icon.

phases.name: Leave yourself an exit after each hit
phases.text: An Evade can interrupt your intended combo. Use short commitments and disengage when it happens; reassess the dormant effect before starting another debuff-based opening.

phases.name: Opening — distinguish a ban from a stop signal
phases.text: Track which actions have been banned and read SP1's symbols. Red light overrides your rotation: release Block and stop every input until the signal ends.

phases.name: Middle — decide whether the instruction counts
phases.text: Check for Grandmaster says before acting. That prefix requires compliance; its absence requires failure. Use openings that do not depend on Stun.

phases.name: Late — reassess your control plan
phases.text: Expect continuous inversion and rising power pressure. Give him space away from his corner. Reverse-control immunity carries a Degeneration penalty in this phase.

phases.name: Finish — separate progress from input direction
phases.text: Track intercept, SP1, SP2 and SP3 completion separately. Blocking preserves the current control direction; other actions toggle it. After a knockout, inspect which protections remain before repeating completed work.
